note: TransformerPath Material Index — input-cost signal for transformer sourcing. Copper and aluminium use the LME 3-month official ring settlement as a latest REFERENCE (varies by day; verify against LME official before commercial use). CRGO, ester/oil and pressboard have no public daily index and are shown as unavailable. Value is an estimate; it is NOT a quote.

rows.name: Copper
rows.note: Record territory; drives winding conductor cost.

rows.name: Aluminium
rows.note: Used for HV winding / foil in some distribution designs.

rows.name: CRGO (grain-oriented steel)
rows.source: No public daily index — negotiated per grade (M-4 / M-OH)

rows.name: Transformer oil / ester
rows.source: No public daily index — mineral oil vs. natural/synthetic ester
rows.note: Ester premium over mineral oil affects sealed units.

rows.name: Pressboard / insulation
rows.note: High-density pressboard for lead exits & barrier/end rings.

cost_impact.assumption: Copper is ≈ 15–20% of a representative power transformer's material cost.
cost_impact.formula: ≈ material cost change = (assumed copper share) × (copper price change %)
cost_impact.example: If copper rises +10% and copper is ~18% of material cost → approximately +1.8% on material cost. Varies by design (oil-immersed power vs. cast-resin distribution).
